goals.title: M12: Game recipe data and simulation contract
goals.objective: Define versioned GameRecipeV1, operation taxonomy, rights-safe nutrition/provenance contracts, deterministic validators, Godot JSON and local SQLite exports, mutation scenario model, and migrate the current 50 published items into the isolated game-data corpus. Prove the public Web remains exactly 50 bilingual items and does not import game data. Complete independent review and quality gates.
goals.evidence: M12 stable commit aa5e9c2; independent code-reviewer APPROVE; typecheck/lint 50 targeted and 406 full tests content:audit game-data:audit production build PASS; canonical 50 drafts 0 unintended exports; Web remains 50 bilingual items.

goals.title: M13: Recipe database first with baking, bartending and dessert categories
goals.objective: Revised 2026-09-11 by Product Director: recipe database first. Grow the recipe database (GameRecipeV1 with RecipeDatabaseExtensionV1) through audited milestones at 120, 250, and at least 500 database entries, covering baking, bartending and dessert categories. Database entries allow empty fields (heat, flavor, images) and loose source classification (web-curated, ai-assisted with mandatory usage notes). Web publication stays at 50 bilingual items; game export keeps the full fail-closed rights/provenance/review gate and never auto-promotes database entries. After Cat Kitchen Goal 8 is merged, deliver a separate adapter proof without breaking replay.
